EC1: Preoperative use of an anticoagulant (Plavix [OR], warfarin [OR], lovenox, etc.)
EC3: History of thromboembolic event (e.g., PE [OR] or DVT)
EC4: History of renal  insufficiency [OR] or failure
EC5: Congenital [OR] or acquired coagulopathy [OR] as evidence by INR  >1.4 [OR] or PTT > 1.4 times normal, or Platelets  <150,000/mm3 [AND] on preoperative laboratory testing
EC6: Use of hormone replacement therapy [OR] or hormonal contraceptive agents within days prior to surgery
EC7: Use of acetylsalicylic acid (ASA) [OR], antiplatelet agents within 7 days prior to surgery
